records.speaker: Item description
records.clean_Japanese: ミツバチが丹念に作り上げた巣。花から集めた蜜がいっぱいつまっており、栄養満点。
records.english: Honeybees build this hive with care. It is packed with nourishing nectar they gather from flowers.
records.previous_English: Honeybees build this hive with care. It is packed with nourishing nectar they gather from flowers.
records.context: Items Gallery and inventory display the same small catalogue card from the original item table.
records.source_meaning: A carefully built honeybee hive full of nutritious nectar collected from flowers.
records.localization_note: Keep the origin of the nectar with the action of gathering it.
protected_phrases: It is packed with nourishing nectar

records.speaker: Item description
records.clean_Japanese: 奇跡の十字架。キリストの没年に作られ、長い間土中に埋まっていたが、没後千年以上経ってから、地表に姿を現した。
records.english: Made the year Christ died, this miraculous cross resurfaced after over a thousand years underground.
records.previous_English: Made the year Christ died, this miraculous cross resurfaced after over a thousand years underground.
records.context: Items Gallery and inventory display the same small catalogue card from the original item table.
records.source_meaning: A miraculous cross made in the year of Christ’s death. It lay underground for more than a thousand years before appearing at the surface.
records.localization_note: Keep the full measure of time together.
protected_phrases: after over a thousand years underground.
